description: Use this when a download link was lost or is about to expire, or a render replied rendering: pass the asset ids from the result to get the links or the status, with no re-render and no charge. Files live about 2 h; verify:true re-checks a file's hash. An id that has expired says so: the same request again returns the same files (the synthesizer is deterministic). Schema 2d544474.
